blocks.text: All-in-one CRM platform that grows with your business

HubSpot has built the most comprehensive free CRM on the market, and it serves as the foundation for a suite of marketing, sales, and service tools. The free tier is genuinely useful - contact management, email tracking, meeting scheduling, and basic reporting - making it the default choice for startups building their first CRM.

As you grow, HubSpot's paid hubs add marketing automation, advanced sales tools, customer service features, and CMS capabilities. The advantage of this all-in-one approach is that every team works from the same customer data, eliminating the sync issues and data silos that plague multi-tool stacks.

The ecosystem around HubSpot - integrations, agencies, training resources, and community - is unmatched. Whatever question you have, someone has answered it. Whatever integration you need, it probably exists.
Contact management, deals, tasks, and email tracking at no cost
Email marketing, landing pages, forms, and marketing automation
Pipeline management, sequences, quotes, and meeting scheduling
Ticketing, knowledge base, and customer feedback tools
Native integrations with virtually every business tool
Custom dashboards and attribution reporting across all hubs

HubSpot's free CRM is the best starting point for startups building their sales and marketing infrastructure. Start free, and upgrade individual hubs as your needs evolve - without data migration headaches.
Our team can integrate HubSpot into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
